t: A Grok Academy course where students write Python to draw with a turtle.
steps: Find the Python Turtle course page on Grok Academy.
Ask your school to arrange School Grok Access and student accounts.
Ask IT to check that the browser allows WebSockets.
Download the teacher notes and lesson plan.
Try the first lesson yourself before class.
Review the Blockly Turtle sibling course for younger or newer coders.
